inputs.style: Hard-driving 1980s heavy metal, cutting heavily distorted guitars, intricate neoclassical riff, roaring articulate male rock voice, explosive drum fills, furious melodic guitar solo. 154 BPM, E minor. an angular high-register guitar answer over a low chug; explosive double-time chorus. Raw heavily overdriven rhythm guitar amplifiers, forceful male English vocals. Complete 280-330 second song, extended developed guitar solo, riff variations, final chorus and decisive heavy ending. Extended instrumental development followed by two emphatic final chorus reprises.
inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Neon bleeds on the cobblestone
Shadows lengthen, the city is stone
We built a throne from a broken spine
And named it holy, named it divine
The blade hangs heavy above my head
A living god for the dead

[Chorus]
Saint of the Guillotine!
Cut the head, keep the scene!
They worship the rust on the iron blade
But I’m still breathing, I’m still made!

[Verse]
His hands are shaking, the sweat is cold
The story of us is getting old
One click of the jaw, one snap of the chain
The false god bleeds out in the rain
I watched the fear turn to hate
Before the lever fell late

[Chorus]
Saint of the Guillotine!
Cut the head, keep the scene!
They worship the rust on the iron blade
But I’m still breathing, I’m still made!

[Bridge]
The rope is cut, the wheel is free
The crowd screams for my liberty
But the silence is the loudest sound
When the king of fear hits the ground

[Solo]

[Chorus]
Saint of the Guillotine!
Cut the head, keep the scene!
They worship the rust on the iron blade
But I’m still breathing, I’m still made!

[Chorus]
Saint of the Guillotine!
Cut the head, keep the scene!
They worship the rust on the iron blade
But I’m still breathing, I’m still made!

[Chorus]
Saint of the Guillotine!
Cut the head, keep the scene!
They worship the rust on the iron blade
But I’m still breathing, I’m still made!

[Chorus]
Saint of the Guillotine!
Cut the head, keep the scene!
They worship the rust on the iron blade
But I’m still breathing, I’m still made!

[Outro]
The lever snaps.
The city wakes.
No more saints.
Just the stakes.
